proposed_capability: P95 + P124 + Trifecta: define screen edge as client-relative camera-edge pan trigger/guard zone (not literal monitor bezel), distinguish intentional brief verified HUD edge clicks/transit from prohibited unattended host pointer dwell, and require admitted input, post-input safe rest, player priority, bounded camera actions, and live-cert falsifiers. Reuse existing camera_traverse and Win32 input ownership, no second controller.
player_save_control_impact: Pure host policy only. A verified UI-edge click remains a candidate subject to independent exact-session scene/save/player/admission controls; never seize a player-owned cursor. Unattended host edge dwell must end with safe interior parking. No Sims input, gameplay state, saves, builds, purchases, or runtime agent launched by this change.
expected_outcome: One canonical machine-readable interpretation of screen edge across host policy, CLI, glossary, docs and tests: transient HUD interaction allowed, unknown world-edge interactions withheld, host idle edge parking requires safe rest, player-owned pointer yields, and observed camera-motion context requires new capture/revision.
negative_tests: Exact 48px threshold and corners on arbitrary client dimensions, not desktop pixel origin
Verified HUD edge click is transient and requires post-click safe rest, without granting execution
Unverified HUD click and world-object edge click do not become executable
Idle edge dwell is forbidden and moved to a safe interior rest only when host owns control
Player-owned pointer never receives automatic host park
Off-client, unknown phase, bool/noninteger coordinates fail closed
Camera movement and post-click stale frame require recapture
Existing camera traverse, world targeting and Win32 mouse primitives retain their contracts
rollback_path: Revert the isolated feature PR on GitHub; no local game or save modifications were performed.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact camera edge-pan trigger geometry and edge-click responsiveness vary by game build, window mode and HUD overlays; requires Windows Sims4 P08 on disposable state.
GitHub CI cannot attest actual mouse movement or camera stability in a running Sims host.
